token.title: Regeneration Credit (RC)
token.intro: The protocol's ERC-20 token. Supply is fixed: every RC starts in the pools and only leaves as a reward for verified work. When someone offsets, the tokens are burned and become a certificate.

protocol.title: Protocol contracts
protocol.intro: The {count} Regeneration Credit contracts on this network. The contracts are immutable and their full history can be checked here.

RegenerationCredit.description: Regeneration Credit token (RC), an ERC-20 with a fixed supply of 1.31 billion. Every token starts locked in the pools and only leaves as a reward for verified work. Burning tokens issues the offset certificate.

RegenerationCreditImpact.description: Calculates the verified impact of the system (trees, biodiversity, carbon and area) and the impact backing each token.

CommunityRules.description: Central user registry: the type of each address, accepted invitations and reports.

InvitationRules.description: Invitation rules: who can invite whom, the delay between invitations and limits per user type.

SupporterRules.description: Open Supporter registration and targeted offsets: burns RC for an impact calculator item and pays 5% to the inviter.

InspectionRules.description: Lifecycle of inspections, from the Regenerator's request to the Inspector's realization and validation.

RegenerationIndexRules.description: Regeneration Index tables used by inspections to estimate a Regenerator's impact (trees and biodiversity).

RegeneratorRules.description: Regenerator rules and data: area under regeneration, coordinates, inspections received and score.

RegeneratorPool.description: Holds the RC allocated to Regenerators and distributes each Era's rewards according to each user's level.

InspectorRules.description: Inspector rules and data: inspections performed, levels and reward eligibility.

InspectorPool.description: Holds the RC allocated to Inspectors and distributes each Era's rewards according to each user's level.

ResearcherRules.description: Researcher rules and data: published research, evaluation methods and impact calculator items.

ResearcherPool.description: Holds the RC allocated to Researchers and distributes each Era's rewards according to each user's level.

DeveloperRules.description: Developer rules and data: development reports published each Era.

DeveloperPool.description: Holds the RC allocated to Developers and distributes each Era's rewards according to each user's level.

ContributorRules.description: Contributor rules and data: general contribution reports (education, translation, design, documentation).

ContributorPool.description: Holds the RC allocated to Contributors and distributes each Era's rewards according to each user's level.

ActivistRules.description: Activist rules and data: invitations of Regenerators and Inspectors and levels earned when invitees complete inspections.

ActivistPool.description: Holds the RC allocated to Activists and distributes each Era's rewards according to each user's level.

ValidationRules.description: Review and voting to invalidate users, inspections and resources.

ValidationPool.description: Holds the validation RC and rewards those who take part in invalidation votes.

VoteRules.description: Defines who can vote on invalidations (eligible Researchers, Developers and Contributors).
